Name: Email Address: Mobile Number: Subject: Feedback: Please wait..."> SUBMIT CANCEL History Share: Home History Show / Hide Page Menu About Us    History    Principal's Message    Vision & Mission    Administration    Affiliation    Visit Us    Contact Us    Internal Complaint Committee (ICC)    Registrar    Dean Academics History of the Institute Government Engineering College Sheikhpura was established in 2019 by the Government of Bihar under the visionary “Saat Nischaya” initiative. The institute aims to expand access to quality technical education, nurture skilled engineers, and strengthen the state’s contribution to the national technical workforce. The college is one of the government engineering institutions established across districts of Bihar under the Department of Science,Technology and Technical Education, Government of Bihar, and is approved by All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). In its initial phase,the institute was affiliated with Aryabhatta Knowledge University(AKU) and operated from the campus of Nalanda College of Engineering, Chandi, which provided a strong academic and infrastructural base during its formative years. In January 2023, the institute shifted to its permanent campus at Bajidpur, near Police Line, in the Sheikhpura district. The new campus is equipped with modern infrastructure, including academic buildings, laboratories, library, hostels, and other essential facilities, creating a conducive environment for academic excellence, innovation, and holistic development. The institute started with four core branches—Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering—each with an approved intake of 60 students, resulting in a total intake of 240 students. In 2023, the institute underwent academic expansion and restructuring. The intake in Mechanical Engineering was revised to 30, while Computer Science and Engineering was introduced with an intake of 120, and Mechatronics Engineering was added with an intake of 30. This led to an overall increase in the total intake to 360 students per academic session. A major milestone in the institute’s evolution was achieved on 15 March 2023, when the institute became affiliated to Bihar Engineering University, Patna.

Abdul Kalam. Prof. (Dr.) Anil Singh Yadav Principal Government Engineering College , Sheikhpura DSTTE, Govt. Of Bihar It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to Government Engineering College, Sheikhpura, an emerging institution under the Department of Science, Technology &Technical Education, Government of Bihar. As a relatively young institution, GEC Sheikhpura stands at a crucial and excitingstage of its journey. While we acknowledge that there are many milestones yet to beachieved and systems yet to be strengthened, we firmly believe that this phase offersus a unique opportunity—to build a strong, value-driven, and future-ready institutionfrom the ground up. Our vision is to nurture technically competent, ethically grounded, and sociallyresponsible engineers who can contribute meaningfully to society and the nation. To our students, I encourage you to take ownership of your learning, explore beyondthe classroom, and actively participate in shaping the culture of this institution. To our faculty and staff, your role is pivotal for academic excellence, research, andmentorship that will define GEC Sheikhpura in the years to come. To our parents and guardians, we assure you that we are dedicated to providing a safe, supportive, and progressive learning environment for your wards. To our industry partners, alumni, and well-wishers, we invite your collaboration, guidance, and support in strengthening our academic ecosystem and enhancing employability opportunities for our students. Together, with collective effort, commitment, and a shared vision, we aim to transform GEC Sheikhpura into a center of excellence in technical education. Let us build this institution—brick by brick, idea by idea—into a place of pride for Bihar and the nation. Prof. (Dr.) Anil Singh Yadav Principal Government Engineering College, Sheikhpura

Established in 2019 under the Department of Science, Technology and Technical Education, Government of Bihar, the college was founded as part of the state’s initiative to expand access to quality technical education under the “Saat Nischay” programme. Government Engineering College, Sheikhpura is affiliated with Bihar Engineering University and approved by AICTE. The institution offers undergraduate programs in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, and Mechatronics Engineering. These programs are designed to provide students with a strong academic foundation, practical skills, and the innovative mindset required to succeed in the rapidly evolving technological world. Our college is committed to creating a dynamic and supportive academic environment supported by dedicated faculty members, modern laboratories, and student-focused learning practices. In addition to technical education, we emphasize the development of communication and global competencies. A modern Language Laboratory provides students the opportunity to learn foreign languages such as Japanese, German, and French, helping them prepare for international careers, higher education opportunities, and global collaborations. As the Registrar, my office is committed to ensuring transparent, efficient, and student-centric academic administration. We strive to maintain high standards in academic governance while supporting an environment that encourages discipline, integrity, inclusiveness, and innovation. I warmly invite you to explore our website to learn more about the academic programs, facilities, and opportunities available at Government Engineering College, Sheikhpura. We look forward to welcoming you to our academic community and supporting you in building a successful and meaningful future.

Strict action is taken against persons flouting this rule; no leniency is shown. Suspension and/or withdrawal from the hostel/ college is the first action against the offender. The Supreme Court of India has also defined ragging as a criminal offense. Definition of student ragging: Any conduct by a student, whether by words spoken or written or by an act which includes physical abuse, lewd acts, teasing, rough or rude treatment, indulging in rowdy, undisciplined and obscene activities which causes or is likely to cause annoyance, undue hardship, physical or psychological harm or mental trauma or raise apprehension or fear in a fresher / junior student or other students or forcing a student to do any act which such a student is not willing to do and which has the effect of causing or generating a sense of shame or embarrassment or danger to a student’s life or adversely affect the physique or psyche of a fresher or a junior student. 1 Anti Ragging AICTE Guidelines Download 2 Anti Ragging Squad Download

Arvind Kumar Head of the Department Department of Civil Engineering Government Engineering College Sheikhpura “Education is not the learning of facts, but the training of mind to think” – Albert Einstein” The Department of Civil Engineering was established in the year 2019. In the 07 years, the department has progressed in various dimensions like academics, research and consultancy which enabled us to enhance knowledge. Our dedicated teaching and non-teaching faculty are supporting all the achievements. Our infrastructure has been state-of-the-art for which we thank our ever-encouraging management. Quality of students and their achievements in curricular, co-curricular and extra-curricular activities have branded our department as a leading centre of learning. The students of the department get into the industry through placements majorly and there is a high inclination towards entrepreneurship and research. The department is supported by a large alumni group. Students are introduced to global challenges and encouraged to take up projects in this direction. I am happy that our students have participated in co-curricular and extra-curricular activities held by our college and other colleges and won prizes. Every academic year our students are bagging VTU ranks, college level academic excellence, sports, and cultural awards.

Shiv Kumar Rajak Head of the Department Department of Mechanical Engineering Government Engineering College Sheikhpura Welcome to the Department of Mechanical Engineering at Government Engineering College, Sheikhpura . It is my privilege to lead a team of faculty and staff who genuinely care about shaping the engineers of tomorrow. Mechanical engineering sits at the heart of every industry, and in this department, we are committed to giving you a strong foundation in the fundamentals—while always keeping an eye on where the world is headed. We believe that being a good engineer is about more than just technical skill. Name: Email Address: Mobile Number: Subject: Feedback: Please wait..."> SUBMIT CANCEL Startup Cell Share: Home Startup Cell Show / Hide Page Menu Activities    Innovation Cell    Startup Cell    Hackathon    Spoken Tutorial Startup Cell Prof. Sandeep Kumar Faculty In-Charge, Startup Cell GEC Sheikhpura The Startup Cell of Government Engineering College, Sheikhpura namely “Sheikhpura Incubation Hub of Entrepreneurship (SIHE)” is a student-driven initiative established to build an ecosystem of innovation, creativity, and entrepreneurship within the college campus. It serves as a bridge between the academic world and the real world of business and enterprise. At our college, we believe that technical education is not only about learning in classrooms — it is also about developing the courage to create something new. The Startup Cell was formed with the purpose of encouraging students to think beyond regular employment and explore the path of self-reliance and enterprise. We aim to provide students with the right environment, mentorship, resources, and guidance to turn their ideas into real startups. Whether a student has a small business idea or a vision to build the next big venture, the Startup Cell is here to support that journey at every step. The Startup Cell regularly organises workshops, seminars, ideation sessions, business plan competitions, and interaction programs with successful entrepreneurs. These activities help students gain practical knowledge, develop problem-solving skills, and understand the basics of running a business. We also facilitate connections with investors, industry experts, and government schemes that support student startups. Our goal is to build a generation of confident, capable, and creative student-entrepreneurs who can contribute not just to their own success, but also to the growth of society and the nation. The Startup Cell is committed to turning the entrepreneurial dreams of our students into reality. Our Mission & Core Values At SIHE, we stand by a few simple but powerful values — curiosity, courage, and commitment. We encourage our students to ask questions, take risks, and never give up on their ideas, no matter how big or small. Our mission is to build a thriving startup ecosystem within the college campus where students from all branches — be it Computer Science, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, or any other — can come together, collaborate, and create meaningful solutions for real-world problems. We actively promote teamwork, peer learning, and knowledge sharing. We also work towards helping students connect with investors, mentors, government bodies, and industry leaders who can guide them in their entrepreneurial journey.

Name: Email Address: Mobile Number: Subject: Feedback: Please wait..."> SUBMIT CANCEL Spoken Tutorial Share: Home Spoken Tutorial Show / Hide Page Menu Activities    Innovation Cell    Startup Cell    Hackathon    Spoken Tutorial Government Engineering College Sheikhpura is an Academic Partner of the Spoken Tutorial Project, IIT Bombay, an initiative of the Ministry of Education (MoE), Government of India under the National Mission on Education through ICT (NMEICT). The program promotes Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) based IT skill development among engineering students through structured audio-video tutorials and certification tests. The Spoken Tutorial pedagogy has also been approved as an IEEE Global Standard in EdTech, making it India’s first internationally recognized ICT-based learning model. About the Program The Spoken Tutorial Project is a remote learning initiative of IIT Bombay designed to: Promote IT literacy through Open Source Software Provide self-paced learning through audio-video tutorials Support certification through online assessments Enhance employability skills of students Provide training aligned with AICTE / UGC recommendations Support multiple Indian languages learning The program is implemented across engineering colleges under MoE Government of India. Official Recognition The Spoken Tutorial Project: Funded by Ministry of Education, Government of India Approved under National Mission on Education through ICT Supported by AICTE & UGC Available on SWAYAM Platform Recognized as IEEE Global Standard Pedagogy Model Courses Offered Under Spoken Tutorial Students are trained in various industry-relevant open-source software tools, including: Programming C C++ Advance C++ Python Java PHP & MySQL Ruby Core Engineering Tools Scilab OpenFOAM Arduino Oscad QCad Ngspice Design & Documentation Tools LaTeX XFig GIMP Blender Inkscape Operating Systems & Platforms Linux Drupal Joomla Git 📄 Training Coverage & Certification Report Department-wise Training Coverage Spoken Tutorial Certification Report (January–June 2025) Spoken Tutorial Certification Report (July–December 2025)
